{"publicationNumber":"306385-2024","noticeIdentifier":"50def2ed-7e25-4b44-a04e-28c555a908af","publicationDate":"2024-05-24Z","formType":"competition","noticeType":"cn-standard","noticeTitle":"Belgium – Environmental services – Support for the evaluation of the EU emissions trading system (EU ETS) and the Market Stability Reserve (MSR) and for the 2026 review of the EU ETS and MSR","procedureTitle":"Support for the evaluation of the EU emissions trading system (EU ETS) and the Market Stability Reserve (MSR) and for the 2026 review of the EU ETS and MSR","description":"The general objective of this contract is to support DG CLIMA in the evaluation of the EU ETS and the MSR, and in the review of certain elements due in 2026, by providing timely and high-quality input for supporting the Commission in drafting its own evaluation report and an impact assessment, in an almost parallel manner, in line with the Commission's Better Regulation Guidelines. The three specific objectives of this support contract are: (1) Support the Commission in drafting an “evaluation staff working document”, in particular assessing the effectiveness, relevance, efficiency, coherence and EU added value of the selected aspects of the ETS Directive and of the MSR Decision, as well as identifying areas of further action in this policy area in view of current and future climate change objectives. Description: The overarching objective of the Framework Contract (FWC) is to support EU Member States in ensuring accessibility and availability of civilian transport infrastructure for military platforms. To this end, the FWC should identify gaps and deficits in logistical capacity related to military transport needs, as well as procedural aspects related to military transport in various dimensions, mapping the current situation and providing EU Member States with information that would serve to improve their Military Mobility capabilities. Moreover, this knowledge will ultimately enable the Agency to propose relevant and concrete actions which will enhance Military Mobility related capability development activities. The overarching objective of the FWC will be achieved through specific contracts (SCs) in the various distinct areas related to logistic capacity, including but not limited to: • Landscaping of capability gaps in logistic capacity for the different forms of transportation (land, air, sea, inland water ways); • Landscaping the legislative framework applicable to movement of military assets; • Assessing the potential for improving the above mentioned capacity; • Providing recommendations for future activities on improved accessibility of civilian transport infrastructure for military purposes.
